_comment: External MCP servers this harness borrows tools from. Each server's tools join the run's deferred tier, so they appear in the prompt catalog and the model loads what it needs (see financeharness/mcp/hub.py). Two transports: a local child process (`command` + `args`) — the path for private data, which never leaves the machine — or a streamable-HTTP endpoint (`url` + optional `headers`). `${VAR}` in any string is expanded from the environment, so tokens stay out of this file. `tools` is an optional allowlist of the server's own tool names (empty = all); `resources: true` also bridges the server's resources as a list/read pair, which is what makes a source with no tools of its own readable. Set `enabled: false` to keep an entry as documentation, `FH_MCP_DISABLE=1` to turn the whole integration off, or `FH_MCP_CONFIG=/path/to.json` to use a different file entirely.
